task:
Create an ordered reading list with a custom start number and two links.

Use one ol with start="3" and exactly two direct li children. The first contains a link to /guides/arrays with text `Arrays`; the second contains a link to /guides/maps with text `Maps`. Each link must have href set to that exact path. Use normal same-tab navigation. No nested lists, additional links or target attributes.

Use only HTML in this file; no JavaScript or CSS is needed. Keep the specified text, element order and attributes. Checks inspect the parsed DOM; whitespace and attribute order do not matter.

## Examples

Input: `["ol", "start"]` → output: `["3"]`.
Input: `["ol > li > a", "text"]` → output: `["Arrays", "Maps"]`.
